architecture_override.critical_guard: single-flow is PER TRANSPORT LANE. A Logical Tunnel may own 1..4 independent complete WBD Transport Lanes. Game/weak-network policy may maintain 2..4 lanes. Any global one-flow reinterpretation, max-lanes=1 rollback, Game disablement, ordinary Reality TCP followed by separate FakeTCP payload, or break-before-make healthy replacement is an ARCHITECTURE REGRESSION. architecture_override.cardinality: Connected product profiles default to Normal=1 and accept active lane counts 1..4; Game desired=2..4; fifth active lane rejected. Profile value 0 is an existing default sentinel that normalizes to Normal=1, not a connected zero-lane state.
architecture_override.multipath: Lanes have independent FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK/FEC state and share Logical Tunnel identity/lease plus one logical SessionID/PacketID race namespace. First arrival wins; duplicates are suppressed; no cross-lane HOL.
architecture_override.replacement: Use generation-fenced make-before-break. Candidate failure preserves healthy old lane. Game rotates one lane at a time.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: Mature FakeTCP ACK/SACK/RTO/recovery and release FEC wire behavior remains frozen unless deterministic lower-layer evidence proves a defect.
